event.description: Repair the LayerNorm-offset pruning candidate by handling absent normalization biases during initialization, then train the same no-offset model.
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Retained incumbent is 3528 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted result; attempt-0009 failed with a reproducible implementation error before training because initialization attempted to zero a None LayerNorm bias; 1 prior attempt. This is the permitted repair of that exact candidate, not a silent retry: initialization now skips absent biases, while all five LayerNorm offsets remain removed and their scales/statistics remain unchanged. Hypothesis: those learned offsets are redundant in the bias-free residual network. This remains a parameterization-preserving scalar compression, not a representational change. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative, RMSNorm, because it isolates the offset parameters without changing the normalization statistic.
